folk.says: Dad builds the hulls. I sweep up after him. One day I'll build my own.

says: Herring, mackerel, fresh cod! Caught this morning, or my name's not Tamsin.
Crabs are a copper each. They'll have your fingers for free.
Lugworms. Under the sand, if you dig fast enough. Dad won't fish with anything else.
Kofi's my dad. He says the fish here are lazy. I think he's just better at it.
